From the arcade

Codebreaker

Crack a four-colour code using the clues from earlier guesses.

Play Codebreaker →

How to play

  1. Click each peg to choose a colour, then click Check code. Use four different colours from the six available.
  2. Right place counts colours in their correct position. Wrong place counts correct colours that belong elsewhere. The feedback does not identify which pegs are correct.
  3. Use earlier clues to narrow down the code. You have eight valid guesses. Incomplete or repeated-colour guesses do not use a turn.
  4. New code cycles between three prepared secret codes. The solution is revealed when the round ends.

Every colour also has a letter or name, so you do not need to distinguish colours alone.
